name: Rising Tides
source:
When a natural disaster hits your town, your sister insists it's related to climate change. But will the town listen?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Rising_Tides]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
一場自然災害襲擊了小鎮，你妹妹堅信這與氣候變遷有關。但鎮上的人肯聽她說嗎？
